about: Physics inputs of the from-scratch pass (PASS_PLAN_2026-10-28 §0/E1): measured OUTSIDE the reconstruction, carried as stated inputs, re-measured on the pass tables in S4. If one moves by more than its error there, the chamber's calibration phase is re-run and the cost written down. Read by rerun/calib/make_bundle.py.

sigma_p0_mm.source: FC (model_audit/followups/fc_sigma0_trade): one sigma0 for both views, SPS-measured and independent of the template (TEMPLATE_STUDY T10); free bench sigma0 is not a measurement (runs to 0.058 mm)

rc_D_x.source: RC diffusion runs along the resistive strips (Y); across them (X) it is 0 (wft.model.build_matrix_rc)

rc_tmpl.source: X-derived template drives both views (TEMPLATE_STUDY T14/T15: Y's own template is worse on all five chambers)

t0_prior_sigma.source: pinned t0 on the bench: t0 = C - 10 ns * ftst from the measured latency, no delta (Dylan 10-29)

rc_D_y.source: H4 beam (decided 2026-10-12); det4 has no partner chamber on the bench

provenance.Dp: unsaturated head-on stack (cloud_basics unsat_width, sqrt(2 Dd)), agrees with Magboltz on det3/det4; det6 keeps 0.018 (its own stack 0.014 +- 0.004 is window-limited). As set by rerun/w12/make_phys_bundle.py (2026-10-25).
provenance.gap_mm: timing-free gaps, gaps.py mean of the two selections (HANDOFF 2026-10-19, cloud_basics FINDINGS §39); det6 the adopted 28 mm.
provenance.v_timing_um_ns: the timing v of each golden row: gap / column duration (w12 timeD bundles; det6 rescaled x 28/30 to its adopted gap, make_phys_bundle.py). It seeds the fit and scales tan = (w - w0) / (kw v); w0/kw are measured per row against M3, so the angle scale does not rest on it.
provenance.rc_D_y_seed: DRC starting points only (recal.py --free rc_D_y --t0-pin --unsat-only refits them); the corrected objective's T6 optimum on det3 is 3.5-3.8e-4 (TEMPLATE_STUDY T6).
